descripcion_geo: Biblical geographical concept covering the lands east of the Jordan: Transjordan, Syria, Mesopotamia.
importancia_estrategica: Symbol of the distant and unknown; source of the 'sons of the east' who are shepherds and wise men.

historias.titulo: The children of the east and their flocks
historias.descripcion: Abraham and his contemporaries are related to 'the sons of the east', nomads and shepherds from the steppes east of the Jordan.

historias.titulo: The wise men from the east in the NT
historias.descripcion: Magi 'from the east' follow the star to Bethlehem to worship the newborn king of the Jews.

historias.titulo: Ezekiel sees the glory enter from the east
historias.descripcion: Ezekiel envisions the glory of God returning to the Temple from the east.

personajes.descripcion: The wise men from the east are the first Gentiles to worship the Messiah.
He envisioned the glory of God entering the restored Temple from the east.
He traveled to the east to find a wife in Paddan; His journey represents the movement between the lands.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: East (the biblical East): relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: The glory of God left the Temple in the east (Ez 11:23) and will return in the east (Ez 43:2); The wise men from the east will worship the Messiah.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The glory of God left the Temple in the east (Ez 11:23) and will return in the east (Ez 43:2); The wise men from the east will worship the Messiah.

cristianismo.descripcion: Jesus was born in Bethlehem; His star was seen in the east (Mt 2:2): the eastern cosmos announces the Messiah of the West.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Jesus was born in Bethlehem; His star was seen in the east (Mt 2:2): the eastern cosmos announces the Messiah of the West.
